Before you book

Check the included assessments, consultations, preparation requirements, price and follow-up. No assessment booking or payment starts on this preview page.

A few useful answers.

Can I bring reports I already have?
Relevant reports can contribute to the assessment discussion. Confirm which reports, formats and dates the selected package accepts before sharing them. This website does not upload or review your reports.
Does Blueprint include a hub membership?
An assessment package is separate from a hub membership. Review the actual package and any ongoing training or follow-up service before purchase.
Is Blueprint included in the Orb app price?
The app plan and professional assessment are separate service choices. Final assessment prices and package inclusions are not confirmed in this preview.
Where can I take an assessment?
Online availability, participating locations and booking destinations are still awaiting confirmation. The preview does not establish availability in a particular city or country.
